label: VERIFIED
extraction: Ralphinho RFC Pipeline recovery and merge queue details. Recovery when unit stalls: evict from active queue, snapshot findings, regenerate narrowed unit scope, retry with updated constraints. Merge queue rules: never merge unit with unresolved dependency failures, always rebase unit branches on latest integration branch, re-run integration tests after each queued merge. Quality pipeline per unit: research, implementation plan, implementation, tests, review, merge-ready report. Outputs: RFC execution log, unit scorecards, dependency graph snapshot, integration risk summary. Unit spec template: id, depends_on, scope, acceptance_tests, risk_level, rollback_plan. Complexity tiers: Tier 1 (isolated file edits, deterministic tests), Tier 2 (multi-file behavior changes, moderate integration risk), Tier 3 (schema/auth/perf/security changes). Inspired by humanplane style RFC decomposition patterns.
